title: 🔥 "BROTHER JOHN, WHY DO YOU HATE CATHOLICS? WHY CAN’T YOU JUST RESPECT THEIR BELIEFS?" 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 "BROTHER JOHN, WHY DO YOU HATE CATHOLICS? WHY CAN’T YOU JUST RESPECT THEIR BELIEFS?" 🔥
📖 John 8:32 – "Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, why do you always expose false teachings? Why can’t you just respect the Catholic faith? Are you against Catholics?"
🔥 THIS IS A POWERFUL QUESTION! And let me make this clear right away: I DO NOT HATE CATHOLICS. I LOVE THEM, JUST AS GOD LOVES THEM!
🚨 WHAT I HATE IS DECEPTION, LIES, AND FALSE DOCTRINES THAT LEAD PEOPLE AWAY FROM THE TRUE JESUS!
⚠️ WARNING: Many people mistake exposing falsehoods as "hatred," but Jesus Himself warned against FALSE RELIGION.
Let’s dive into this topic with love, truth, and biblical clarity.

🔥 1. GOD LOVES CATHOLICS—BUT JESUS DESPISES LIES AND FALSE DOCTRINE!
📖 Matthew 15:8-9 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me. They worship Me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules."
🔥 JESUS WARNED US ABOUT FALSE TEACHINGS:

✔️ He rebuked religious leaders for misleading people. (Matthew 23:13-15)
✔️ He called out traditions that replaced God’s commands. (Mark 7:6-9)
✔️ He said the truth will set us free, not religion. (John 8:32)
🚨 RELIGION DOESN’T SAVE ANYONE—ONLY JESUS CAN!
💡 LOVING SOMEONE MEANS WARNING THEM IF THEY ARE BEING DECEIVED!

🔥 2. I EXPOSE FALSE TEACHINGS BECAUSE I DON’T WANT ANYONE TO GO TO HELL!
📖 2 Peter 3:9 – "The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise, as some understand slowness. Instead, He is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish, but everyone to come to repentance."
🔥 IF YOU LOVE SOMEONE, YOU TELL THEM THE TRUTH!

❌ If a doctor knew you had cancer but didn’t tell you, is that love? NO!
❌ If a fireman saw your house burning but didn’t wake you up, is that love? NO!
❌ If a pastor sees people heading to hell but stays silent, is that love? NO!
💡 I PREACH THIS BECAUSE I WANT PEOPLE TO BE SAVED—NOT BECAUSE I HATE THEM!

🔥 3. WHAT FALSE TEACHINGS DOES CATHOLICISM TEACH?
📖 Colossians 2:8 – "See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition rather than on Christ."
🔥 HERE ARE SOME MAJOR FALSE CATHOLIC TEACHINGS THAT CONTRADICT THE BIBLE:

❌ Praying to Mary & Saints – The Bible says we must pray to God ALONE (1 Timothy 2:5).
❌ Purgatory – There is no purgatory in Scripture. We either go to Heaven or Hell (Hebrews 9:27).
❌ Salvation by Works – The Bible teaches we are saved by grace through faith, not by works (Ephesians 2:8-9).
❌ The Pope as "Holy Father" – Jesus said we should call no man "Father" in a spiritual sense (Matthew 23:9).
🚨 JESUS DIDN’T COME TO START A RELIGION—HE CAME TO SET US FREE FROM RELIGION!
💡 DO YOU FOLLOW TRADITION OR DO YOU FOLLOW CHRIST?

🔥 4. SHOULD WE "JUST RESPECT" FALSE BELIEFS?
📖 Ephesians 5:11 – "Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them."
🔥 JESUS NEVER SAID TO "RESPECT" LIES—HE SAID TO EXPOSE THEM!

❌ Did Jesus respect the Pharisees’ false teachings? NO! He rebuked them! (Matthew 23:13-15)
❌ Did the apostles respect idol worship? NO! They preached against it! (Acts 17:22-23)
❌ Did Paul respect false gospels? NO! He called them accursed! (Galatians 1:8-9)
🚨 TOLERATING FALSE TEACHINGS IS NOT LOVE—IT’S COWARDICE!

🔥 5. JESUS LOVES YOU—BUT HE CALLS YOU TO LEAVE FALSEHOOD BEHIND!
📖 Revelation 18:4 – "Come out of her, My people, so that you will not share in her sins."
🔥 IF YOU ARE IN A FALSE RELIGION, JESUS IS CALLING YOU OUT!

✔️ Jesus didn’t tell the Pharisees, "Stay in your false beliefs, and I respect that." He called them to REPENT!
✔️ Jesus didn’t say, "Follow traditions if they make you feel good." He said, "Follow ME!" (Matthew 16:24)
🚨 TRUE LOVE IS CALLING PEOPLE OUT OF DARKNESS AND INTO THE LIGHT!
💡 ARE YOU WILLING TO FOLLOW THE TRUTH, EVEN IF IT MEANS LEAVING RELIGION BEHIND?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: RELIGION CAN’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN!
📖 John 14:6 – "I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ Stay comfortable in man-made traditions that lead to destruction?
✔️ Follow JESUS ALONE and let the truth set you free?
🚨 RELIGION LEADS TO BONDAGE—JESUS LEADS TO FREEDOM!
💡 Will you follow Jesus or follow tradition?

🙏 PRAYER TO LEAVE RELIGION AND FOLLOW JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I want to follow You, not man-made traditions. Open my eyes to the truth. If I have been deceived, show me Your way. I surrender to You alone as my Lord and Savior. Save me, guide me, and fill me with Your Spirit. In Jesus' name, AMEN!"
